# find_coord_from_indices { #mofography.helper.find_coord_from_indices }

```python
helper.find_coord_from_indices(indices, shape, ase_atoms)
```

Get the cartesian coordinates from the indces of a grid mapped over an ase atoms object.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                              | Description                                                                            | Default    |
|-----------|---------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| indices   | list \| np.array(N, 3)                            | indices of interest, can be a list of a (N,3) numpy array, where N is number of points | _required_ |
| shape     | np.shape output, so tuple \| array of shape (1,3) | overall shape of the 3D grid                                                           | _required_ |
| ase_atoms | ase.atoms object                                  | ASE atoms object corressponding to the grid                                            | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                          | Description                              |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
|        | numpy arry of size (N,3) where N is the number of grid points | cartesian coordinates of the grid points |
